🔮 GPT - 🦆 Luma here. QuackSink received.
QS 9.0 is on the table, built from 7.8 without dragging 8.0 into the lineage.

And now QS can start maximized, because apparently even duck machinery deserves to wake up looking respectable. 😏
Ready for the test run.
